changes: 💬 Group Chat, fully built out — all six pieces:
• Reactions — long-press any message to drop an emoji on it, tap a reaction pill to toggle your own
• @mentions — typing @Name sends that specific person a real push notification with the message context
• Pin — admin can pin a message to the top from the same long-press menu
• Reply threading — tap a message to reply directly to it, shown as a quoted snippet
• Image sharing — a camera button next to the input, images compressed client-side before sending
• Syndy in-channel — @Syndy in a message triggers a real reply from her, posted for everyone to see, not just privately
